limits.en: Storybook itself is fully free open source with no usage limits; only its optional cloud companion Chromatic has paid tiers.

keyLimits.en: No feature limits; self-hosted, no included cloud visual testing/publishing.

addOns.en: Chromatic (cloud visual testing and Storybook publishing) starts around $149/month for teams, separate from Storybook itself.

cautions.en: Storybook the tool is entirely free; only the optional Chromatic cloud service (visual regression testing, hosted Storybook) is paid, and pricing for it was not directly re-verified in this session.

capabilities.en: Build and preview UI components and pages in isolation from the main application, outside of business logic and app state.
Interaction testing and visual regression testing of components directly from stories.
Auto-generates living documentation for a component library from stories and component metadata.
Large open-source ecosystem: reports over 80 million installs per month and 90k+ GitHub stars, with a large addon ecosystem.

limitations.en: Storybook itself does not include hosted publishing or cloud visual-diffing; that requires a separate paid service such as Chromatic.
Requires initial setup and configuration inside a project's build tooling (webpack/Vite) and ongoing maintenance as the app's dependencies evolve.

reason.en: Storybook is commonly used alongside React component development; not a direct substitute but frequently paired.

missingAlternatives.name: Ladle
missingAlternatives.reason: Lightweight Vite-based alternative to Storybook for isolated component development

missingAlternatives.reason: Vite-native component workshop tool, direct Storybook alternative for Vue/Vite projects
